title: Cargo-Hold Tyrant
text: Cargo-Hold Tyrant wears the chained remains of a captured hauler and fights as a one-person boarding fortress. On loss, suffer 2 Wounds.
flavor: Its armor still bears the inventory numbers of the crew inside.

defeatReward.text: Cargo-Hold Tyrant is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
